editorial:
Imagine waking up every day as a completely different person. That is exactly what you get in this wild ride. You follow a man who has a very rare condition where his personality changes based on the day of the week. The story is told from the point of view of the Tuesday version of himself. He has to leave notes and clues for his other selves to figure out what is going on in his life. It feels like a puzzle that you are solving along with him, and the mood is a mix of confusion and curiosity that keeps you glued to the screen.

What really makes this work is the acting, as the lead actor does a great job showing how each day feels different. The twists are surprising and the pace moves quickly so you never get bored. While it can be a bit confusing at first, it pays off in the end. If you love a good mystery, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you really love the visuals, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best quality.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the man discovers his other personalities are not just random, but are reacting to a deep trauma. You find out that the Wednesday version of him is the most dangerous and is hiding the truth from everyone else. In the final scenes, the Tuesday version finally catches up to the truth. He realizes he cannot just live with these split versions of himself and must find a way to merge his mind to move forward.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves puzzles and twisty psychological stories.
